review.reviewer: Implementation owner (self-review against .github/workflows/ci.yml job consumers, hermetic HTTP contracts, and delivery_source.py boundaries)
review.decision: Proceed with classifying .openspec.yaml and quality-only guard scripts as policy-only, scoping Go core/CLI packages to test+cross-build, and retaining explicit HTTP/artifact/relay downstream suites and fail-closed defaults
review.notes: Verified internal/app/client_contract_test.go enforces tests/contracts/http-contract.json in the Go test job, LocalArtifactPreviewTests.swift exercises internal/artifact + serve in menubar, relay-worker shares APNs shape with relay/, and scripts/ci.py + api/contract.md + tests/contracts/ remain full-matrix.

evidence_limits: Unit tests in scripts/ci_test.py verify deterministic path classification, rename/deletion preservation, and workflow job aggregation; real GitHub Actions execution is exercised on the PR itself.

cases.description: OpenSpec .openspec.yaml metadata files and quality-only guard scripts select policy/docs only without triggering platform builds
cases.setup: Paths including openspec/changes/foo/.openspec.yaml, openspec/changes/archive/2026-11-27-foo/.openspec.yaml, scripts/openspec_check.py, scripts/workflow_guard.py, scripts/test_design.py, and scripts/check-comment-language.py.
cases.action: Call scripts/ci.classify on the policy/guard path list and on unknown scripts.
cases.expected: Recognized OpenSpec metadata and quality-job guards select [] (policy/docs only); scripts/check-design.sh and Go security guards select ['test']; scripts/ci.py and unknown scripts still force full CI.

cases.description: Non-HTTP Go core/CLI packages select test and cross-build while HTTP server, artifact, and relay packages include their exact downstream consumers
cases.setup: Paths in cmd/gtmux/main.go, internal/radar/agents.go, internal/hq/playbook/en/workspace.md, internal/server/server.go, internal/artifact/store.go, and relay/apns.go.
cases.action: Call scripts/ci.classify on each Go path group.
cases.expected: CLI/core Go and embedded HQ playbook select ['cross-build', 'test']; relay Go adds 'relay-worker'; artifact Go adds 'menubar' and 'web'; server Go adds 'menubar', 'mobile', and 'web'; api/contract.md, tests/contracts/, assets/, and go.mod remain full.

cases.description: Git rename and deletion classification preserves Go/contract scope and rejects symlinks
cases.setup: NUL-delimited git diff records and a temporary git repository renaming Go/contract files into docs/ and adding a symlink.
cases.expected: Renaming a Go file into docs/ retains Go checks rather than collapsing to docs-only; renaming api/contract.md into docs/ remains full; symlink changes raise ValueError.

cases.description: Full-impact shared contracts, dependencies, CI selector edits, and missing/skipped required jobs remain fail-closed
cases.setup: Shared contract/dependency paths (api/contract.md, go.mod, scripts/ci.py, tunnel-worker/src/index.ts) and simulated CI job result maps with missing/skipped/failed/cancelled entries.
cases.expected: Shared/uncertain paths select all CI jobs and any non-success required job fails ci.verdict.
